messages.subject: Interactively change the selectInput choices?
parts:
Originally I create this shiny interface that takes in a parameter "company id" and "date", but here we have a problem: most people dont know the companies we work with by their id, only their name, i.e. (McDonalds, Radioshack). 

I would like to be able to search for a list of similar names based on my search function on the server side and pass it on to the selectInput panel. 

Is there a way to do so? 

Also posted on SO: 
http://stackoverflow.com/questions/16173325/r-shiny-is-there-a-way-to-create-a-search-function-for-input-parameters

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Interactively change the selectInput choices?
parts: Sure, just use a textInput for the search string, and use renderUI/uiOutput to make a dynamic selectInput. Then the rest of your code can depend on the selectInput's value. (Make sure to check for NULL or whatever when reading the selectInput value, because it will start out with no value.)
